findings.current: अभी भी अनुलग्नक संग्रह में सुरक्षित है ({digest})
findings.proposed: अभी भी अनुलग्नक स्टोर में सुरक्षित है ({digest})
findings.rule: Terminology consistency (core glossary, 'one term, one decision'; task rule b: 'store' must read as the app's attachment storage). The product's settled Hindi rendering for a data store is the loanword स्टोर — ui.settings.imports.* ('स्रोत स्टोर'), ui.settings.integrations.use_integrations.keys_not_saved ('एन्क्रिप्टेड स्टोर') — while संग्रह is the collection/archive noun and संग्रहित is this product's label for *archived* (ui.chat.dialogs.archive_action, ui.projects.project_model.archived). 'अनुलग्नक संग्रह' therefore reads as an attachment collection/archive, not the digest-addressed attachment store.
findings.note: Meaning is still recoverable; the defect is the wrong store term and the archive collision, not a misunderstanding of retained-vs-deleted.
